service.description: Promo photos and live performance video for Colorado musicians and bands, shot by a Denver booking agency with event planners in mind.

props.title: Band photos and live video for Colorado musicians.
props.lede: We book live music for weddings, corporate events and private parties across Colorado, so we know what a planner wants to see before they hire a band. We shoot promo photos and live video for musicians with those questions in mind.

props.title: What do event planners look for in a band?
props.lede: When a planner is choosing between a few acts, they're usually asking three questions.

rows.term: Can I see them play to a real crowd?
rows.text: A clear live clip with good sound tells a planner more than any bio can.

rows.term: Will they look right at my event?
rows.text: Photos that show how you dress and carry yourself on stage help them picture you at their event.
Current photos that match across your website, your socials and your booking pages tell them you're organized and easy to work with.

props.title: Promo shoots and live video for bands

rows.text: For acts that need current photos for a website, socials, press and booking pages. You'll get edited photos, sized for the web and social media, shot at a real venue or in a performance setting.
For acts that need a clip a planner can watch and trust. You'll get edited performance clips with clean sound, cut for booking pages and social media.

props.html: Want both? We can plan the photos and the video together in one session.

rows.text: Send links to the photos, video and website you have now, and let us know what you need.

rows.term: Get a quote and plan the shoot
rows.text: We'll send you a quote, and then we'll plan the look, the location and the songs that show you at your best.
We can shoot at a gig you already have, which is often the best option, or at a set we arrange with you.
You'll get everything edited and sized for booking sites, socials and press, usually within a week of the shoot (depending on the project).

props.title: Questions about band photos and video

items.q: Do I need to be on the Signet roster?
items.a: No. We shoot for any musician or band in Colorado, whether or not you play events with us.

items.q: Do you help with what to wear for band photos?
items.a: Yes. We'll go over it with you before the shoot, so you look like you belong at the events you want to play.

items.q: How much do band photos and live video cost?
items.a: We quote every project to fit the act and what you need. Tell us about your act and we'll send you a quote.

props.title: Tell us about your act.
props.lede: Send us what you have now and what you need, and we'll get back to you with a quote.
